definitions.gloss: allied nation; ally; member state of an alliance
definitions.explanation: A country that is part of a formal alliance, especially a military or political one.

examples.japanese: {同盟国|どうめいこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}する→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{同盟国|どうめいこく}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Japan is an important ally of the United States.

examples.japanese: {首脳会談|しゅのうかいだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{同盟国|どうめいこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧な⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: At the summit, strengthening cooperation with allied nations was a major agenda item.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧ (alliance) and {国|こく} (country). Frequently appears in news coverage of international relations, diplomacy, and security policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同盟国|どうめいこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: relations with allied nations
- {同盟国|どうめいこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧: to support an ally
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{同盟国|どうめいこく}: major ally
- {同盟国|どうめいこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: obligations to allies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {友好国|ゆうこうこく}: friendly nation — countries with good relations but not necessarily a formal alliance
- ⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧: alliance — the alliance itself, not the member country
- {連合国|れんごうこく}: allied powers — historically refers to the Allied Powers in the World Wars
- ⟦{加盟国|かめいこく}→加盟国：19160_kameikoku⟧: member state — a country belonging to an organization like the UN
